budgets.label: Under ₹2,000
budgets.expect: At this level, expect simple quartz (battery) watches. Look at build, strap and case size first, and keep your expectations realistic.

budgets.label: Under ₹3,000
budgets.expect: There is usually more choice in dial finishes and straps. Quartz watches are the norm, so judge the strap and the details.

budgets.label: Under ₹5,000
budgets.expect: Look for better finishing, a more solid strap or bracelet and a clearer dial. Some watches at this level add scratch-resistant glass, so check the listing.

budgets.label: Under ₹10,000
budgets.expect: You may see more refined finishing and metal bracelets. Compare the glass, the case material and the warranty on each listing.

brands.name: Titan
brands.blurb: A well-known Indian watch brand from the Tata group, with a wide range of classic analog watches.

brands.name: Timex
brands.blurb: An American watch brand known for simple, easy-to-read classic watches.

brands.name: Casio
brands.blurb: A Japanese brand. We cover only its analog watches here, not digital or smart ones.

brands.name: Fossil
brands.blurb: An American brand known for fashion-led classic watches.

brands.name: Fastrack
brands.blurb: A youth-focused brand from Titan Company, with value-oriented analog watches.

brands.name: Sonata
brands.blurb: A value brand from Titan Company, with simple classic watches.
